name: Dusk Canyon Voxel Engine
promptTemplate: A demoscene voxel landscape flyover through {{canyon_theme}} with {{altitude_mode}} elevation, {{fly_speed}} flight speed, {{fog_density}} fog density, {{fov_angle}} field of view, and {{audio_reactivity}} music modulation.

canyon_theme.hint: Swap shader lookup palette and sky gradient

altitude_mode.hint: Clearance above chasm peaks and gorge floors

fog_density.hint: Distance haze blended into the horizon sky

audio_reactivity.hint: Bass bounce on flight deck altitude and speed

gallery.blurb: A voxel landscape flyover in the manner of early-90s heightmap engines: a procedural heightmap and colour map rendered column by column, front to back with a y-buffer, the camera gliding low over valleys at dusk with distance fog.
gallery.prompt: A voxel landscape flyover in the manner of early-90s heightmap engines: a procedural heightmap and colour map rendered column by column, front to back with a y-buffer, the camera gliding low over valleys at dusk with distance fog. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
